summary: First testing run of CloudPay foundation. Ran the existing pytest suite (13 tests) plus a new extended suite (9 tests) covering dashboard summary, providers, fee rules, settlements, feature flags, users/roles, refunds, tenant creation and Google session endpoint — 22/22 backend tests pass. Verified end-to-end UI flows: login as super admin, tenant switch to Acme, dashboard KPIs (Gross Turnover, Net Volume, Success Rate, Tenants) + Volume by Status chart, payment creation ($100 → succeeded, fee $3.20, net $96.80), sandbox decline for amount ending .13 (T-DECL failed), refund → partially_refunded, settlement generation, feature-flag list (kyc_aml/refunds/vda_settlement — regulated ones disabled), Access Control (users + roles with Super Admin), providers list contains 'mock', monitoring shows all 3 regulated boundaries DISABLED, Google button initiates redirect to auth.emergentagent.com. No critical bugs found.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix Dialog components

action_items: Spec/impl testid mismatch (documentation only — UI works): review request lists 'nav-access-control' and 'nav-feature-flags', but implementation uses 'nav-access' and 'nav-features'. Also 'refund-amount-input' / 'submit-refund-button' testids not present on the refund modal (uses plain 'Process Refund' text button and an unlabelled number input). Align docs or add testids for future regression stability.
Feature flag key naming mismatch: spec calls out seed key 'vda' but implementation seeds 'vda_settlement'. Not blocking; align naming.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent to remove a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: routers cleanly namespaced with /api prefix, RBAC enforced via deps.require_permission, tenant isolation via resolve_tenant_id — verified by 401/403 tests.
Payment engine idempotency verified end-to-end (same key returns same payment id).
Live-mode provider registration correctly blocked with 400 (safeguard against real-money processing).
All regulated boundaries (KYC/AML, VDA, AI/Voice) correctly reported as disabled in /api/monitoring/services.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, axios withCredentials, cookie-based auth — works over HTTPS preview URL.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed tenants, users, and fee rules during pytest runs. Also generated multiple payments/refunds/settlements on Acme Commerce tenant via UI (visible in Payments, Refunds, Settlements grids).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend foundation are fully functional. Existing tests at /app/backend/tests/test_foundation.py (13) and /app/backend/tests/test_extended.py (9) form a good regression baseline. Auth over localhost requires Bearer token extracted from Set-Cookie (Secure cookies dropped over http). Frontend nav testids are 'nav-access' and 'nav-features' (not '-control'/'-flags' as some docs say). Feature flag key for VDA is 'vda_settlement'. Login default lands on a non-platform tenant selected via topbar 'tenant-selector' with option testids like 'tenant-option-acme'.
